heroSummary: The Bambu Lab X1C is an optimal match out of the box for eSUN ABS+, utilizing its fully enclosed chamber and hardened steel direct drive toolhead to comfortably achieve print speeds up to 214 mm/s at an 18 mm³/s volumetric flow limit. Thanks to the integrated chamber temperature management, you achieve strong interlayer bonding and zero warping without requiring hardware modifications.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate or Engineering Plate + PVP Glue Stick (acts as interface/release agent)
slicerTweaks: Cap Maximum Volumetric Speed at 18 mm³/s under Filament Settings to prevent underextrusion at high speeds.
Set Chamber Temperature regulation target to passive soak by keeping the door and top lid fully closed; disable auxiliary part cooling fan (0%) to eliminate layer separation.
Configure first layer nozzle temperature to 255°C and bed to 100°C, stepping down to 250°C and 95°C for other layers to maximize initial bed adhesion.
Enable Pressure Advance calibration with an initial manual value around 0.025 to keep sharp corners crisp without bulging at high acceleration.

troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Chamber air temperature too cold at start of print, or draft induced by the auxiliary fan.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Preheat the bed to 100°C for 15 minutes before printing to heat-soak the chamber to >40°C, turn off the aux fan completely, and add a 5mm outer brim.

troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Excessive part cooling airflow quenching extruded filament before adequate polymer chain diffusion occurs.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Lower maximum cooling fan speed to 20-25% and increase printing temperature from 245°C to 255°C.

troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Filament moisture absorption causing steam expansion at the 250°C nozzle exit.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Dry the eSUN ABS+ spool in an active filament dryer or on the X1C heatbed at 70°C for 6 to 8 hours before loading into the AMS.

faq.question: Can I print eSUN ABS+ with the Bambu Lab X1C door or top glass open?
faq.answer: No. ABS+ requires an enclosed, elevated thermal environment to prevent differential thermal contraction, which causes delamination and bed peeling; keep the chamber fully sealed.

faq.question: Do I need to run the Auxiliary Cooling Fan for eSUN ABS+ on the X1C?
faq.answer: No, set the Aux Part Cooling Fan to 0%. Strong localized airflow onto ABS induces localized shrinkage and severe layer separation.

faq.question: Is glue stick necessary on the Textured PEI plate for ABS+?
faq.answer: While ABS sticks well to clean textured PEI, a thin layer of glue stick is recommended primarily as a release agent to prevent high-adhesion ABS+ from tearing the PEI coating upon removal.

faq.question: How do I reach the 214 mm/s max safe speed without quality loss?
faq.answer: Ensure the Max Volumetric Speed is set to 18 mm³/s in OrcaSlicer, maintain a steady 250°C nozzle temperature, and ensure your chamber is preheated above 40°C.
